note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as PlayStation publishes it. The hidden flags follow the official list's hidden trophies (28 hidden, confirmed by Output Lag and GTA Vibes). Exactly one trophy is missable: Positive Mental Attitude.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Plan on around 200 hours in total; the long tail is the 100% checklist, not the story.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, at the start of Chapter 1.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Unmissable: finish Chapter 1. It can pop at the start of Chapter 2 rather than on the last cutscene.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Unmissable: finish Chapter 2.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Unmissable: finish Chapter 3.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Unmissable: finish Chapter 4.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Unmissable gold: finish the final story mission. Keep a manual save from just before it, because there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: finish the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. Switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after it.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: finish the mission The Cartel Heist.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: finish the mission Child's Play.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: finish the mission Headliners.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: finish the mission VCIA Takedown.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: finish the mission Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Gold for 100% completion, the last trophy for most players. The checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion only after the story, but work done earlier still counts. It needs, among other things, 300 stunts, 70 of the 80 Challenges, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 illegal operations and 200 of the 277 vehicles. Budget about 100 hours after the story.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count. You need 250 for the trophy, but keep going: 100% completion needs 300.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type the game offers once: races, fishing, the arcade, the shooting range, drone races and the rest. Trying is enough; you do not need to win any of them.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, across the game's shooting ranges. Learn each range's scoring first, then chase the golds one range at a time.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races: different events, not the same race 20 times. Mix street races, drone races and the other race types as they open up.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the game's activities; take the challenge against Cal when it is offered and out-fish him.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game. Any of the four in-game arcade games counts, so pick the one you find easiest.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia-only questline: finish Andy's final mission. Side-story finales stay open after the credits, so there is no rush.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's final mission. Side-story finales stay open after the credits, so there is no rush.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's final mission. Side-story finales stay open after the credits, so there is no rush.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some questlines count: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not, because they have their own trophies. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. Do the Chapter 3 race Race Against Yago the moment it appears: it is time-sensitive (hourglass icon) and the strand counts toward this trophy.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's final mission. Side-story finales stay open after the credits, so there is no rush.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's final mission (Jason-only). Side-story finales stay open after the credits, so there is no rush.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE MISSABLE TROPHY. Meditate at every spot across Leonida; spots show as purple icons when you are close. Each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. Do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1: after Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning (a morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time). She heads out to the balcony of Jason's house to meditate; follow her and accept the optional task. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and there is no mission replay, so keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Jason-only hunting questline for Bret Vogel: hunt a unique animal for him. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are found across Leonida; a set is complete when you hold every card in it, so keep picking cards up as you travel.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations. Scanning a vehicle with WAiNK also counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive and the count climbs on its own.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges, listed under Progress > Challenges. Many complete on their own while you play; 100% completion needs 70 of the 80.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star Wanted Level and escape the heat. Easiest during a bank vault job, which gives 4 stars straight away; escaping one with your partner earns this too. It pops once you have left the red heat zone.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. It can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before you hit a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive. 100% completion needs 200 of the 277 base models.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is slow-motion aim: press L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and take down 5 with one use of Combat Focus, using an assault rifle. Adrenaline extends Focus.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge; planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. The planes at gates E3 and E4 work. Go up to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed: fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first, because the police come fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get into a military tank (a Rhino). Tanks should be parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it; kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If someone spots you, reload rather than push on.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. The 100% checklist needs all eight vaults.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore every area of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel by car, plane and on foot, so finish the story first and then mop up the corners you never visited.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this pops along the way.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch; the official description is the only hint: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. It may pop while you play normally. Check back once players confirm the exact trigger.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch; the official description is the only hint: smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. It may pop while you play normally. Check back once players confirm the exact trigger.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley: Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: It should pop when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch; the official description ('Second time's the charm') is the only hint. It may pop while you play normally. Check back once players confirm the exact trigger.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch; the official description ('What the hell just happened?') is the only hint. It may pop while you play normally. Check back once players confirm the exact trigger.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch; the official description ('Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by') is the only hint. It may pop while you play normally. Check back once players confirm the exact trigger.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs, and you launder them by selling them to your contacts. The $250,000 total is cumulative.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop, so it climbs as you play normally.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy the eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
trophies.name: On the Spot
